title: tags-definitions
description: Shared tag definitions for PlanB Network content schemas. Single source of truth for valid tags and their meanings.

tag_item.description: A tag from the PlanB Network predefined tag list

tags_array.description: List of tags from the PlanB Network predefined tag list

x-tag-descriptions.proof-of-work: Referring to all things needed to prove some job has been done
x-tag-descriptions.software: Regarding programs, services you use after being installed on servers, PCs and smartphones
x-tag-descriptions.mining: All topics related to BTC mining
x-tag-descriptions.fees: Aspects referring to every cost when it comes to send BTC value (in any way)
x-tag-descriptions.hardware: Every hardware-related topic, mutually exclusive with the hardware-wallet-ready tag
x-tag-descriptions.hardware-wallet-ready: Content compatible with hardware wallets, mutually exclusive with the hardware tag
x-tag-descriptions.wallets: Every tool allowing to manage or spend bitcoin
x-tag-descriptions.investment: Bitcoin is an investment, but in which way it's up to the topic of the content
x-tag-descriptions.keys: Every topic regarding storage of the secrets to spend bitcoin
x-tag-descriptions.market-trends: The market rules everything, and we may identify some trends
x-tag-descriptions.finance: Addresses all aspects regarding how money and financial system work
x-tag-descriptions.onchain: Aspects referring to Bitcoin blockchain only
x-tag-descriptions.offchain: Every aspect referring to Bitcoin, with the exclusion of the blockchain
x-tag-descriptions.lightning: Everything that is about Lightning Network
x-tag-descriptions.decentralization: Aspects referring to one of Bitcoin's most important feature
x-tag-descriptions.smart-contracts: Regarding a self-executing contract with the terms of the agreement directly written into code
x-tag-descriptions.DIY: Do it yourself, stands for every hardware project you can build on your own, with some raw material
x-tag-descriptions.node: Every software agent that validates and relays information, contributing to the functionality of that specific network
x-tag-descriptions.backup: Explore ways how to improve redundancy of secret keys storage
x-tag-descriptions.use-case: Openly and directly addressing specific use cases for something
x-tag-descriptions.user-friendly: When a topic shows content with the goal of being easily understandable by beginner and intermediate bitcoiners
x-tag-descriptions.historical: Content telling about historical bitcoin facts and data. It may also be intended for both general and economic history when dealing with Bitcoin's origin
x-tag-descriptions.scalability: Topics regarding difficulty to scale one of bitcoin-related networks
x-tag-descriptions.protocols: Whenever topics regard separate sets of rules, where each one governs how participants interact and maintain consensus
x-tag-descriptions.layers: Different protocols can lay on different levels between each other and versus Bitcoin mainnet
x-tag-descriptions.sidechains: It is about independent blockchains that run parallel and bound to the Bitcoin main chain
x-tag-descriptions.personal-security: Topics referring to security aspects with focus on threats suitable for physical people
x-tag-descriptions.network-security: Topics with the focus to security aspects of the network
x-tag-descriptions.privacy: Main focus here would be to preserve end-user sensitive information that can lead to personal identification
x-tag-descriptions.regulation: Sometimes talking about laws, compliance, regulation in general is important
x-tag-descriptions.risks: Highlight potential danger of bitcoin custody and usage
x-tag-descriptions.future-outlook: Information and hypothesis regarding future happening (and problems) that the network could face
x-tag-descriptions.adoption: Topics regarding using bitcoin for everyday purchases, its roles such medium-of-exchange and store of value
x-tag-descriptions.case-studies: Content presented in a way of an Harvard business case study
x-tag-descriptions.good-practice: Suggest specific actions when it comes to do something, and explain why
x-tag-descriptions.innovation: It is about new features over the Bitcoin protocol
x-tag-descriptions.cypherpunk: Refers to content promoting, explaining and applying any cypherpunk value
x-tag-descriptions.self-sovereignty: Different from cypherpunk, it links content that are still focused on the individual without requiring him/her to be a cryptographic/tech expert. This concept's boundary is laying more on a day-to-day physical level
x-tag-descriptions.DIY-IT: Do it yourself, stands for every software project you can develop on your own, with some examples and guidance from a reliable source
x-tag-descriptions.consensus: Topics referring to security of the network facing incentive mechanisms that bring order over chaos
x-tag-descriptions.development: Discussion on potential features that may be useful, really experienced users may invest energy into this topic
x-tag-descriptions.interoperability: Topics facing the possibility of mutual interaction between parts of network
x-tag-descriptions.technical-analysis: Aspects analyzed from perspective of their technical feasibility
x-tag-descriptions.update: Tracks the presence of updates on tutos and courses over time
x-tag-descriptions.legacy: Meta-tag that identifies old procedures and resources not available anymore
x-tag-descriptions.deep-dive: The selected tag explains something deep, regardless of its actual bitcoin-grade content
x-tag-descriptions.easy-explain: Describe if a content needs simplified writing style
x-tag-descriptions.experimental: Meta-tag that addresses features, ideas, concepts that are still not available for immediate use, but that will be better known in the next future
x-tag-descriptions.business: About companies and startup in the Bitcoin ecosystem
x-tag-descriptions.evaluation: The content, whatever it would be, is about assessing the skills and abilities of its users
